sources.name: ux-audit
sources.application: Recognition and recovery before visual polish
sources.proof: Search, explicit states and actual failure/recovery browser checks.

sources.name: ui-polish
sources.application: Rejected as the primary method for a fundamentally weak design; used only after layout replacement
sources.proof: Desktop and mobile are inspected separately after interaction correctness.

sources.name: e2e-testing-for-webapps
sources.application: Separate functional assertions from visual inspection; drive actual controls
sources.proof: tools/test_dashboard.py starts the real local HTTP handler and exercises every visible control.

sources.name: operationalizing-expertise
sources.application: Tie each observed failure to an executable acceptance boundary
sources.proof: ChartEvidenceTest retains dips and invalid intervals; study metadata never claims a skill was applied.

sources.name: repeatedly-apply-skill
sources.application: Serial focused passes, baseline preserved, commits between useful changes
sources.proof: Evidence projection, layout and interaction, then cold-start/failure checks; no independent subagent claim.

sources.name: interactive-visualization-creator
sources.application: Applicability-limited: reject its cinematic stack and decorative motion for this operations dashboard
sources.proof: Plain SVG, one selected-node history, exact sample inspection and visible missing spans.

sources.name: agent-ergonomics-and-intuitiveness-maximization-for-cli-tools
sources.application: Use discoverable, machine-readable steps; not an unperformed whole-CLI scoring exercise
sources.proof: Private study-plan helper and the existing bootstrap/capabilities commands; no invented quality score.
